QuestDescription: Our first priority is to capture the Sun's Reach Sanctum.  Once we've secured it, we'll be able to use its energy to open a portal from Shattrath.$B$BThe sanctum is overrun with the Wretched - former blood elves who've devolved into mindless husks of their former selves.  Its defenses would've normally prevented this intrusion, but the Wretched have stolen the power sources from the protective wards.$B$BHunt down the Wretched and get the mana remnants they carry.  Use them to energize the sanctum wards.
LogDescription: Captain Theris Dawnhearth at the Shattered Sun Staging Area wants you to obtain 4 Mana Remnants from Wretched Fiends and Wretched Devourers and use them to energize one of the Crystal Wards surrounding the Sun's Reach Sanctum to the east.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Captain Theris Dawnhearth at the Shattered Sun Staging Area in Isle of Quel'Danas.

QuestDescription: I have devised a plan to acquire a power source strong enough for the creation of our portal.$B$BThe ethereal forces at Bash'ir Landing, atop the northwestern Blade's Edge Mountains, have been smuggling mana cells out of Tempest Keep and transporting them to the Sunwell for Kael'thas.$B$BThey have hidden the cells, but there is a way for you to find them; the ethereal carry phase devices that you can use to see the smuggled goods.$B$BJust beware the mana cells' phase wyrm guardians.
LogDescription: Obtain 10 Smuggled Mana Cells and return them to Exarch Nasuun on the Terrace of Light in Shattrath City.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Exarch Nasuun at Lower City in Shattrath City.

QuestDescription: Greetings, $r.$b$bI'm afraid I have little to offer here until my reagents are stocked.$b$bOf the supplies I require, there is a special reagent, razorthorn root, that is particularly difficult to harvest.$b$bFortunately, I know a secret....$b$bUsing the glands of the Razorthorn flayers, one can control a ravager there and use it to expose a root.$b$bTo find the roots, travel to Outlands and fly northeast from Shattrath until you reach Razorthorn Rise.
LogDescription: Mar'nah at Sun's Reach Harbor wants you to travel to Razorthorn Rise in Outlands, collect 5 Razorthorn Roots, and return to her.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Mar'nah at Sun's Reach Harbor in Isle of Quel'Danas.

QuestDescription: We lack the numbers to capture the Sanctum at Sun's Reach, but I've a plan that will tip the scales in our favor.$B$BThe loose energy from the Sunwell has caused the sentries that patrol this island to malfunction.  The crystal cores that control their behavior are damaged beyond repair.$B$BI've crafted new crystals that will bring them under our control; place them inside of the hulls of defeated sentries.  We will need all the help we can get.
LogDescription: Vindicator Xayanna at the Shattered Sun Staging Area wants you to place the Attuned Crystal Cores inside 5 defeated Erratic Sentries to turn them into friendly units.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Vindicator Xayann at the Shattered Sun Staging Area in Isle of Quel'Danas.

QuestDescription: The Legion will move against us as soon as their forces to the south are freed up.  The Scourge at the Dead Scar are keeping their forces occupied at the moment.  It won't last long, however.$B$BI want you to fly a dragonhawk over to the scar and put a dent in the demons' numbers with these arcane charges.$B$BIf all goes well, they won't even notice us taking the armory from Kael's lackeys.  Talk to Ayren, the dragonhawk master in the west part of the harbor, when you're ready to fly there.
LogDescription: Battlemage Arynna wants you to speak to Ayren Cloudbreaker when you're ready to fly over the Dead Scar.  Once there, use the Arcane Charges to kill 2 Pit Overlords, 3 Eredar Sorcerers and 12 Wrath Enforcers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Battlemage Arynna at Sun's Reach Sanctum in Isle of Quel'Danas.

QuestDescription: Supplies are inbound, or so I'm told.$b$bRegardless, we can ill afford to wait around hoping that help arrives before our offensive stalls. We must make the best of what we have.$b$bAs for me, I need ore to fashion an anvil so I can begin to upgrade our armor and weapons.$b$bThere are a group of naga on the coast to the east of here collecting ore and placing it in chests for shipment to the Legion.$b$bRelieving them of their ore will help our efforts in more ways than one....
LogDescription: Smith Hauthaa in Sun's Reach Armory wants you to kill Darkspine Myrmidon to the east and use their keys to steal three pieces of the ore from their chests.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Smith Hauthaa at Greengill Coast in Isle of Quel'Danas.

QuestDescription: One of Kael's most elite forces, the Dawnblade army, has been stationed at the Sun's Reach Harbor and Dawnstar Village.$B$BThe harbor is of critical importance to our plans, so any Dawnblade casualties you inflict will be of tremendous help.  Kael'thas will rue the day that he turned his back on his people and sided with the Burning Legion.
LogDescription: Magister Ilastar at Sun's Reach Armory wants you to slay 6 Dawnblade Summoners, 6 Dawnblade Blood Knights and 3 Dawnblade Marksmen.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Magister Ilastar at Sun's Reach Armory in Isle of Quel'Danas.

QuestDescription: We're making a push to solidify our control of Sun's Reach by capturing the harbor next.  Unfortunately a fleet of Dawnblade reservists is on its way to reinforce Kael's forces there.$B$BTake this oil and secure a dragonhawk from Ayren Cloudbreaker.    You should be able to fly within reach of the ships' sails; once you're close enough, set them on fire.$B$BLand in one of the ships and attack the reservists.  With their ship sails on fire they won't be able to mount much of a defense.
LogDescription: Vindicator Kaalan at the Sun's Reach Armory wants you to speak to Ayren Cloudbreaker and fly over the Dawnblade reinforcement fleet.  Use the Flaming Oil to set the ship sails on fire as you fly and once you land, slay 6 Dawnblade Reservists.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Vindicator Kaalan at Sun's Reach Armory in Isle of Quel'Danas.

QuestDescription: We've taken Sun's Reach from the enemy and our final victory is at hand.  The cost was high and many brave combatants gave their lives so we could achieve this.$B$BIt is my goal to ensure that those who perished in combat are not forgotten.  I ask that you take a moment to consider making a donation towards a memorial fund.  Any leftover gold will go to the widows and orphans of the fallen.
LogDescription: Anchorite Ayuri at Sun's Reach in Sunwell Isle wants you to donate 10 gold.

QuestDescription: I and my Shamans have gathered our powers for the coming battle with the Lord of Frost.  $n, you will be the fist of the Earthmother.$B$BTake this magma totem.  Use it against the Ice Stone, to the northeast.  Ahune is channeling his power through this stone; it is our hope that the totem will disrupt him and cut off his link to the elemental planes.$B$BIf fortune is with us, then, perhaps, we can defeat him.$B$BPrepare yourself, $n.  If Ahune comes to face us, then his fury will be great.
LogDescription: Bring the Earthen Ring Magma Totem to the Ice Stone.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ice Stone at Darrow Hill in Hillsbrad Foothills.

QuestDescription: Staring into the card, the image blurs until you see yourself standing covered in the furs from many wolves and bears.  You can only assume this is your destiny should you invoke the tarot's power.
LogDescription: Collect 12 Torn Hides and then summon the Huntsman with the Hunting Tarot.  The Torn Hides can only be gathered from beasts of level 5 or higher.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Jonathan LeCraft in Designer Island.

QuestDescription: Coren Direbrew is in the next room, riling up Dark Iron dwarves for another attack on Brewfest.  Defeat him!$B$BGo to Coren and pick a fight.  Tell him his beer isn't fit for pigs.$B$BWhen you do that, be ready for a fight.  The last person who insulted his brew... was fed to dire boars.
LogDescription: Speak with Coren Direbrew.

LogTitle: Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients
QuestDescription: The fight in Northrend is not only against the armies of the Lich King, but also against those of the Horde.$B$BA powerful titan relic has been found in the Strand of the Ancients.  As you might know, we dwarves have been custodians of such artifacts for years and as such we're their rightful keepers.$B$BIn this case, the Horde has developed a keen interest in pilfering the relic from the titan ruins.  They're certain to use it as a weapon against us; we must do whatever we can to stop them.
LogDescription: Win a Strand of the Ancients battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

LogTitle: Call to Arms: Strand of the Ancients
QuestDescription: Just because we march into Northrend to smash the Scourge, doesn't mean we get to take a break from crushing the Alliance.$B$BThose Explorers' League dwarves have found the location of a powerful titan relic and we'll be damned if we let the Alliance take control of it.$B$BGo, $n, and destroy our enemies.  Make them see that no matter where we meet, they remain our sworn enemies.

QuestDescription: Come closer. No, not too close. Don't want any unnecessary suspicion now, do we?$B$BThis coliseum requires more lumber than we've stockpiled and there's no way I'm going to pay to have it shipped in from Grizzly Hills. At the western end of Crystalsong Forest, by the Great Tree, grow a number of young Crystalsong oaks. They'd provide just the kind of planking we need for building and scaffolding. Take this axe, use it to fell the trees and then hew them into planks, but don't let anyone see you!
LogDescription: Bring 12 Rough Hewn Planks to Bezzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Bezzle Blastbolt at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

LogTitle: A Chip Off the Ulduar Block
QuestDescription: Getting stone for this job has been a nightmare, I tell ya! There are tons of stone available from ruins in safe places, but those holier-than-thou paladins won't go for it. Something about 'priceless artifacts.'$B$BAnyway, whining about that isn't going to get this place built. There are tons of crumbling titan ruins in the Foot Steppes and at the Inventor's Library in Storm Peaks. Take my, uh, 'chisel' with you and see if you can break those huge blocks into useful pieces.
LogDescription: Bring 15 Small Stone Blocks to Bozzle Blastbolt at the Argent Tournament Grounds.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Bozzle Blastbolt at Argent Tournament Grounds in Icecrown.

QuestDescription: My sword was lost at sea.  Catch it and bring it back!
LogDescription: Old Man Barlo in Crystalsong Forest wants you to bring him the Sword of Knighthood.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Old Man Barlo in Terokkar Forest.

LogTitle: Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest
QuestDescription: As we get closer to victory in Icecrown, it's become more apparent that our armies are going to have to deal with the Horde before they can deal with the Lich King.$B$BThe elite guard known as the Kor'kron has been deployed to block our advance in the Isle of Conquest.  The isle is of vital strategic importance, $n.  See to it that our lads prevail!
LogDescription: Win an Isle of Conquest battleground match and return to an Alliance Brigadier General at any Alliance capital city, Wintergrasp, Dalaran, or Shattrath.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Alliance Brigadier General.

LogTitle: Call to Arms: Isle of Conquest

The Alliance have reached the same conclusion and have sent the Seventh Legion to wrest control of it from our forces.$B$BGo, $n, and ensure that the Horde prevails at any cost!

QuestDescription: This ledger is full of locations, and I need you to investigate and take action, pal. This has gone on long enough.$b$bHere's an entry I want you to check out: it's right outside Orgrimmar's gates, to the west! That can't be good. Get out there and rough 'em up.$b$bOh, and if you see something big and dangerous enough that it needs destroying, toss this bomb at it.
LogDescription: Kill 5 Crown Lackeys and use Snagglebolt's Khorium Bomb to damage one Chemical Wagon just west of Orgrimmar's gates in Durotar, then return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt in Orgrimmar.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Detective Snap Snagglebolt.

QuestDescription: We must move decisively against the wolvar if we're to have a chance of survival. However, I worry that in our zeal, too many of them will be slain.$B$BThe Snowfall Glade wolvar have as much right to exist as do we. You and I will see to it that they get that chance.$B$BIf Elder Ko'nani hasn't asked you already, he will ask you to deal with them.  While you're upon the glade to the north, I'd like you to bag up their pups and bring them back to me.
LogDescription: Collect 12 Snowfall Glade Pups. Deliver them to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Trapper Mau'i at Moa'ki Harbor in Dragonblight.

QuestDescription: This is the wrong choice. Accept the quest, "The Warden's Charge." Those quests are more fleshed out.
We should be okay here for now, and they have need of you in the Firelands. You should go through the portal and help them out.
LogDescription: Speak to General Taldris Moonfall at Malfurion's Breach on the Molten Front.

QuestCompletionLog: Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.
Return to Morthis Whisperwing at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

QuestDescription: Several of our scouts have reported seeing what seemed to be living flames skittering around the surfaces of Fireplume Peak.$B$BIf the reports are accurate, we need these for study immediately. We've yet to fully understand where all of the attacking elementals come from, and these could well lend us significant insight.
LogDescription: Retrieve 6 Animate Embers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Arthorn Windsong at the northern end of the Furnace on the Molten Front.

QuestDescription: It is time for our training session.$B$BFollow me around the spires. Let's see if you can keep up while staying mounted.
LogDescription: Follow Instructor Windblade.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Instructor Windblade at The Arboretum in The Jade Forest.

QuestDescription: Sprites again! I hate these things. We need to stop them before they hurt someone or burn down half of the village!$B$BIf you see any of the pests, please deal with them!
LogDescription: Kill 8 Slateskin Troublemakers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

LogTitle: Steer Clear of the Beer Here
QuestDescription: Someone left some beer out up on the southern rise and now the sprites have developed a taste for our brew. They've been sneaking into town all morning, stealing whatever kegs they find.$B$BBring back what you can. A pandaren worker without brew is just... it won't be very productive. We need the men in good spirits.
LogDescription: Recover 10 Stolen Mistfall Kegs.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I don't know if you noticed, but my town is burning...$B$BThe sprites have started kicking the braziers! They're going to set fire to the whole town!$B$BPlease help us! Stamp out any fires you see!
LogDescription: Put out 30 Brazier Fires.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Hard workers deserve hearty meals, but I'm all out of good meat!$B$BCan you head out into the forest and get me some fresh gazelle meat?
LogDescription: Retrieve 10 slabs of Fairlands Gazelle Meat.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Cook Tope at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The villagers have lost another yak this morning to one of the thundermaw wolves from across the river. The wolves grow bold.$B$BThis is a sign that they are breeding beyond the vale's ability to sustain them. It's time to thin their numbers again.$B$BIf you are willing to aid me in this, you would have my sincere appreciation.
LogDescription: Kill 8 Thundermaw Wolves.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Would you do a humble merchant a favor? I've been needin' to refresh my stock of eternal blossoms. They grow in the woods nearby.$B$BCould you help me out, perhaps?
LogDescription: Collect 10 Eternal Blossoms.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Merchant Benny at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Building a new village makes for hungry workers it seems!$B$BI have a hearty stew recipe prepared, but I need some lushrooms from the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east. Apparently there are roused spirits causing trouble up there though, and I'm not very well suited for the violent life.$B$BIf you're heading up the burial grounds today, could you collect some lushrooms for me?
LogDescription: Collect 12 Lushrooms.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Cooke Tope at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The vale has been quiet all morning. I'm sending Rook with a cart of supplies out to the XXX Village. You should join him.
LogDescription: Ride a delivery cart to XXX Village.

QuestDescription: We used to have the trainees clear out the ruins of spiders as part of their training, but now we send them straight to the mogu front. The spiders have gotten out of control.$B$BCare to put things back in control?
LogDescription: Kill 8 Ashweb Spiders.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Okay, these spiders are seriously creeping me out. Especially those egg sacs they leave lying around that I keep accidentally stepping on only to be covered in very little but very creepy spiderlings. Ug, makes me shudder just thinking about it.$B$BI say you burn them. Burn them all.
LogDescription: Kill 50 Ashweb Spiderlings. Use Kun's torch to burn them inside their pods.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Hello, friend.$B$BOne of Leven's men brought word to me of a mogu artifact in the eastern ruins, but said he couldn't figure out how to retrieve it. I suspect it's guarded by one of their rune locks.$B$BIf you go to the artifact, you should find four runes somewhere nearby that when activated will release the lock. If you could bring the artifact back to me, I would be very grateful.
LogDescription: Retrieve the Ancient Mogu Artifact.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sinan the Dreamer at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: In the walls of the ruins themselves, there are precious runestones that we can make use of back in the eastern vale.$B$BIf you see any while you are within the ruins, would you be so kind as to bring them back to me?
LogDescription: Collect 12 Guo-Lai Runestones.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sinan the Dreamer at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: My dear Kun spotted more spiders pouring out of the Guo-Lai Halls this morning, and when he went to investigate, he uncovered another spider matriarch inside.$B$BI need you to kill it.
LogDescription: Kill Bloodtip, the Ashweb Matriarch.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: A small group of mogu have been sighted on Ruin's Rise, to the north.$B$BExtinguish them.
LogDescription: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on Ruin's Rise.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: One of the quilen statues in Guo-Lai Halls came to life and nearly killed my precious Kun. I won't have it! No one threatens my Kun.$B$BI want you to go in there and smash the thing to pieces. I'd do it myself, but I need to attend to my lover's wounds first.
LogDescription: Kill Wulon, the Granite Sentinel.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The wood sprites are back. I need you to kill them before they cause anymore trouble.
LogDescription: Kill 8 Stonebark sprites.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I need more pomfruit! Go knock some loose from the trees for me, would you?$B$BTake this, I use it when I go harvesting. Things go quicker when the fruit comes to you!
LogDescription: Gather 12 Pomfruit.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Cooke Tope at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The hawk numbers in the vale are thriving. This is opportune for our fletchers, for we will need a great number of feathers if we are to keep the archers upon the wall stocked with arrows.$B$BIf you would not mind, could you aid us in gathering these feathers?
LogDescription: Gather 80 Silken Feathers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Hi! So, I have a dilemma. I've only got one good wolf name.... wait for it... Cracklefang! I know, amazing right?! But now there are TWO big nasty wolves in the forest, which is all kinds of confusing.$B$BI need you to kill one of them so I can free up the name. Should be simple enough, yeah? Especially for someone of your incredibleness.$B$BSo, are you on board? I'm hoping for yes!
LogDescription: Kill Cracklefang.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Vicejaw! Sounds absolutely violent, does it not? I came up with it myself, and I think it's very suiting. I tried to wrestle my staff away from him for hours, but he simply would not let go!$B$BOkay, it was really more like a few seconds. I like to be truthful to my friends, even if it makes my stories significantly more boring.$B$BAnyway, would you be so kind as to release your oh-so-potent wrath upon this crocolisk with a vice-like jaw, and then kindly bring my staff back? Preferably in-tact!
LogDescription: Kill Vicejaw and return Ren's Longstaff.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Quid is a very powerful and very ancient water spirit, though you might not know it with his child-like ways.$B$BThis morning, Quid nearly killed several villagers in the bar when he jokingly caused several of the water kegs to explode.$B$BAs long as the water flows, Quid will remain. He cannot be slain. But he can be reminded that we do not take his dangerous antics in jest.$B$BWould you be willing to carry this message to him on behalf of the village?
LogDescription: Defeat Quid, the Spirit of the Misty Falls.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: It seems Aetha has been levitating the livestock and dropping them into the river again. The mayor has requested that we remind her that these kinds of jokes are not welcomed.$B$BWould you be so generous as to travel to the ridge above the village and teach her this lesson? You cannot kill her, you can only send her away for a time, but this should prove a potent reminder.
LogDescription: Defeat Aetha, the Spirit of the Golden Winds.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: In the Tu Shen Burial Ground to the east, the spirits of ancient mogu are locked in battle with the spirits of our pandaren ancestors that rose up against them. The spirits have seen no rest since the return of the mogu to the valley.$B$BIf you would be willing to go to the graveyard and force the mogu to relive their defeat again, we might offer some lasting peace to the spirits of our ancestors.
LogDescription: Kill 8 Ancient Mogu Spirits.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The spirits of our ancestors are reliving one of the most revered battles in our history at the Tu Shen Burial Grounds to the east.$B$BDo as I ask, $r, and honor their gravestones. Remind them that they are respected even these many years later, and that they are deserving of peaceful rest.
LogDescription: Honor 6 Pandaren Gravestones.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: You can hear the spirit of Lao-Fe, the Slavebinder shouting taunts from the cave at the top of Tu Shen Burial Mound.$B$BDefeating him will surely serve to ensure victory for the spirits of the pandaren monks.
LogDescription: Kill the Spirit of Lao-Fe, the Slavebinder.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: There are mantid on top of the wall. The defenders on the ramparts are calling for help!
LogDescription: Kill 10 Krik'thik mantid on the Gate of the Setting Sun.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: We sent some scouts towards the Five Sisters to the north to try and find whatever mogu leader has risen up to direct their movements in the valley. Few have returned.$B$BI'd like to think they're just off downing too much ale or being irresponsible with some young pandaren, but they may actually be in some trouble.$B$BCan you scout for the scouts? And see if they've turned up any information on that leader while you're at it?
LogDescription: Recover 3 Shado-Pan Scout reports.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Some of the mantid have made it on top of the wall. There's some risk they'll route the soldiers we have posted there if their numbers are large enough.$B$BI need you to get on top of the wall and help clear out any that have broken through.
LogDescription: Kill 10 Krik'thik mantid on top of the Gate of the Setting Sun.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

LogTitle: Roll Club: Vale of Eternal Blossoms
QuestDescription: Follow the flags. Make the checkpoints. Round the loop. Get back to me before your time is up.$B$BSpeak to me when you're ready to roll.
LogDescription: Complete the Vale of Eternal Blossoms roll course.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kelari Feartherfoot at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Scouts reports place the displaced Shao-Tien Imperion at the north end of the wall.$B$BAngi Autumnlight spelled out your goal in no uncertain terms: find this leader and kill him.
LogDescription: Kill Bai-Jin the Butcher.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: A giant beast has burrowed under the gate into the courtyard. The defenders need your help!
LogDescription: Kill Kri'chon, the Corpse-Reaver.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: This is one of the challenges I put upon my warriors during peaceful times to keep them strong and fast. Let's see how you fare.$B$BSurvive the ring for 90 seconds without getting pushed out or killed. Stay on your toes.
LogDescription: Enter the Survival Ring and survive for 90 seconds without leaving.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: A giant mantid is terrorizing the inside of the wall. It seems doubtful that the defenders will be able deal with it without you.
LogDescription: Kill Vyraxxis, the Krik'thik Swarm-Lord.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The Shao-Tien are on their heels. Most of them retreated to Winterbough Glade after their last defeat. We should press the advantage.$B$BTake the fight to these mogu in the clearing to the northwest. Let us leave them no minute of rest as long as they remain in the Vale.
LogDescription: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu in Winterbough Glade.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mantid forces are pouring against the wall. I've arranged for some flying serpents to cut away at their forces from the air.$B$BWould you be willing to take the reigns on one of them?
LogDescription: Use a Shado-Pan Sky Serpent to kill 60 Krik'thik attackers, 3 Krik'thik War Wagons, and 3 Krik'thik Catapults.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I've been staring down into the waters of the lake, pondering life, love, and everything beautiful, and suddenly I realized that the sparkles in the water aren't just a reflection of my radiant personality, there are actually some sort of shining objects down there! Surely valuable.$B$BWould you mind taking a drip and relieving the lake's depths of its mysterious sparkles? Pretty please?
LogDescription: Recover 8 Shining Rubies.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: <He leans over and draws a picture of what can only be a mogu, points towards the lake to the west, drags the blunt side of his dagger across his throat, and looks at you expectantly. It seems he wants you to kill mogu at Whitepetal Lake.>
LogDescription: Kill 6 Shao-Tien mogu at Whitepetal Lake.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to He Softfoot at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu have erected their filthy banners around the lake to the west, claiming it as their own. Take this torch and show them what we think of their banners.
LogDescription: Burn 10 Shao-Tien Banners.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Sometimes I feel sorry for these mogu... maybe ripping out the spirits of other races is just their way of coping with family issues at home? Maybe we should be more sympathetic to where all this aggression stems from?$B$BOr we could just smash all their soul-stealing ritual objects down at the lake. That sounds more fun to me personally.
LogDescription: Destroy the Shao-Tien Ritual Statues.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ren Firetongue at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The water has been frothing with danger this day! Some sort of swarming, meat-eating fishy nastiness has taken up residence in our lake! Deplorable. And just when I was considering stripping down to my nothings to take a mid-day dip!$B$BYou are adept in the ways of slaughtering any manner of nasty, are you not? Would you put your skills to use this day, in the name of pandaren everywhere desiring a swim?$B$BIt's a truly noble cause, especially with me among their ranks!
LogDescription: Kill 9 Knifetooth Swarmers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: There were some scouting reports unaccounted for after the attack. If we're lucky, they're still out in the village, but the mogu may have gotten their hands on some of them as well.$B$BIf you could bring back any scouting reports you find, it would definitely put my mind at ease. We can't afford to let the mogu in on our positions or any of the artifacts we've found, lest the men be in even more danger than they already are.
LogDescription: Recover 3 Wu Kao Scouting Reports.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Many villagers are cornered and scared, unable to defend themselves. You will need to defend them. Rescue them.$B$BGo quickly friend, save as many as you can!
LogDescription: Rescue 6 Cornered Mistfall Villagers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Leven sent Rook here to stop mogu, but there are more than Rook can kill alone.$B$BYou help?  Rook will tell Leven you helped.  Promise.
LogDescription: Kill 6 Shado-Tien attackers in Mistfall Village.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

LogTitle: My Town, It's On Fire Again
QuestDescription: I don't know if you noticed, but my town is on fire... again.$B$BWe have water buckets all over town, but no one can get out to put out the fires. Please, please, help us!
LogDescription: Use Mistfall Water Buckets to douse 60 fires.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Mayor Shiyo at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Mogu stealing peoples minds! Making them do evil things.$B$BDon't kill them, just kill the mogu, then they forget about all the mogu mind stealing and stop being evil. You should fix people like Rook is.
LogDescription: Free 6 Dominated Guards by killing their controllers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Mogu stone dog creatures chasing villagers and hurting them. Rook try to smash some, but they too fast.$B$BYou help smash some too?
LogDescription: Kill 8 Stonebound Quilen.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I've been talking to Tantan here... again... and he insists that fishing is some kind of fabulous. I was skeptical, but I gave it another go. I'm not a big fan of that whole holding a stick and waiting method though, so I tried something a bit more direct.$B$BWould you be a doll and go collect any of the still intact fish floating belly up in the lake for me?
LogDescription: Collect 12 Stunned Whitepetal Carp.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu are taking over the minds of the saurok at the lake to our west and turning them against us! The thing is, they were already against us, so I'm not sure they really thought this thing through fully.$B$BAnyway, Anji's the fighter in this pair, I'm more the lover, so I'm looking for someone to do all the weapon swinging and spell flinging and war crying and such.$B$BCan you go kill some saurok for me?
LogDescription: Kill 8 Dominated Paleblade Flesheaters.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The Shao-Tien Mindbenders have taken over the minds of our defenders down at Whitepetal Lake to the west. Get down there and kill the mogu that are controlling them, but don't kill the defenders! Killing their captors should free them from their mind control.$B$BSooner would be better. Anji might try to go down there to help soon, and her ability to restrain herself when in the heat of things is not one of the qualities I married her for.
LogDescription: Beat 8 Possessed Whitepetal Defenders until they're freed of mogu possession.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mindbenders at Whitepetal Lake are pulling the spirits from the corpses of the dead to inflict who-knows-what kind of torments upon them.$B$BI've written on this scroll a rite that will release their spirits from their bodies and send them on their way. Where they go and what happens to them from there I don't know, but it will at least free them from the cruel hands of the mogu.$B$BRead this rite over any of the fallen you find. We'll recover their bodies later.
LogDescription: Read the Rite of Release at the bodies of 6 Fallen Golden Lotus Defenders.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Big mogu leader is here! Up behind village. If we kill big mogu leader, Leven be happy with us for sure!$B$BYou been good at helping Rook. Want to help more maybe? Please?
LogDescription: Kill Gaohun the Soul-Severer.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Big mogu leader is here! Up behind village. If we kill big mogu leader, Leven be happy with us for sure!$B$BYou been good at helping Rook. Want to help more maybe? Please?
LogDescription: Kill Baolai the Immolator.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu think they can inhabit these ruins uncontested. Let's show them the error in their ways.
LogDescription: Kill 8 mogu in the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu have forced spirits into their old statues to bring them to life, control them, and turn them against us.$B$BThe only way to free the bound spirits is to destroy their vessels.
LogDescription: Destroy 6 Mogu Statues.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu have taken prisoners. They'll be tortured or worse.$B$BFind any way you can to free them from their cages.
LogDescription: Find a Shao-Tien Cage Key and free 6 Golden Lotus Prisoners.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: There is no more sure message we can send them then to burn the tents the sleep in.$B$BScour the ruins. Destroy every tent you find.
LogDescription: Burn 6 Mogu Tents in the Ruins of Guo-Lai.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Scouts spotted a Shao-Tien Imperion entering the Guo-Lai Halls. I need someone I can trust to make sure he doesn't come out of there alive.$B$BI think you're the $c for the job.
LogDescription: Kill the Shao-Tien Imperion.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Hey! You know what awesome thing happened to me this morning?$B$BI was strolling through the ruins with Anji, eyes on the ground so I wouldn't step on anymore of those creepy spider pods, when one of the statues came to life and tried to smash me!$B$BAnji ended up doing the smashing. But I'm not satisfied. I think that you should go out there and smash all the statues, whether they're moving or not. It's the only way to be sure.
LogDescription: Destroy 10 Mogu Statues.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: You know He Softfoot? Sneaky guy, don't talk much. He put traps all over ruins for mogu. He said Rook just need to trick mogu into traps. Rook don't really know how.$B$BMaybe you do it? You find traps, you get bad guys into traps? Can you not tell He though, please?
LogDescription: Lure 8 enemies into He's Poison Traps.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rook Stonetoe at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Good to have you with us, $c. If you're joining the fight, I need more men out up at the Golden Stair to clear out the mogu setting up base there.$B$BCan I count on you?
LogDescription: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu on the Golden Terrace.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Leven always says the only good quilen is a dead quilen, and I'm inclined to agree. You here to aid the cause?
LogDescription: Kill 6 Granite Quilen.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu have been sending their narcissistic stone effigies onto our battlefield today. They're brining them to life up on the Golden Stair.$B$BThe bigger they are, the harder we hit'm. You in?
LogDescription: Destroy 6 Mogu Effigies.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu have bent the will of sky serpents and turned them against us.$B$BThe defenders won't fare well against them, but you would. Head northwest towards the Golden Stair and remove them from the sky.
LogDescription: Kill 3 Subjugated Serpents.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: If I had to pick the most important quality for a battle standard, it would be that it's standing up... and not on fire, but mostly the first one. So needless to say, I'm a bit concerned about our standard situation at the moment.$B$BIf some unknown $c were to be so kind as to take a walk out on the battlefield to our northwest and stand our standards back up, both myself and my extremely sexy yet somewhat commanding wife would be very grateful.
LogDescription: Erect 6 Golden Lotus Standards.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: A foolish contingent attempted to mount an offensive on the Golden Stair through the eastern pass, and were bombarded by cannons. Those that made it back are in bad shape, and there are still wounded out in the field.$B$BHere are some bandages. Use these, or any other healing skills you possess, and help get our wounded defenders back to safety.$B$BPlease hurry, there is little time.
LogDescription: Heal 6 Wounded Defenders.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: <He looks down at the dead fog creature at his feet, looks up at you, then points out into the mists surrounding the lake. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these fog creatures.>
LogDescription: Kill 8 Fog Walkers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: <He looks down at the dead saurok at his feet, looks up at you, then points out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these saurok.>
LogDescription: Kill 8 Paleblade Saurok.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I would not normally ask this of grizzle $c such as you, but since you are to be on the battlefield below the Golden Stair anyway, would you recover spent arrows for the archers?
LogDescription: Recover 12 Spent Shado-Pan Arrows.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Che Wildwalker at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I came upon one of the Shao-Tien Soul-Render's daggers. It radiates a strong magic. I've been told it should allow you to enter their spirit vortexes.$B$BThe mogu use these to harvest spirits and bind them to their will, but I'm hoping you can use it to free the spirits.$B$BEnter any of the spirit vortexes you can find up on the Golden Stair, and free all the captive spirits you find.
LogDescription: Enter Spirit Vortexes and free 15 pandaren spirits inside.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: For the life of me, I can't figure out why the mogu would have built all their statues and such down in that lake. I'm sure there wasn't always water down there, but it still seems wickedly inconvenient should it ever have rained.$B$BAh well, who's to fathom the strange intentions of the mogu...$B$BWould you be so kind as to swim down there and bring back any artifacts that seem even vaguely carry-able? I'd certainly appreciate it.
LogDescription: Recover 8 Mogu Artifacts.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Some of the best fishin' in all of pandaria in this lake right here. I brought enough brew to last me all day, but I didn't think to bring any bait.$B$BWho can really remember such things?$B$BIf you'd be willing to gather me some bait along the shore, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?
LogDescription: Gather 12 Fresh Whitepetal Worms.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Merchant Tantan at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I came out for a beautiful day of fishin', but I didn't think to bring a pole. There are so many things to remember for fishin', I just can't keep it all in my head.$B$BThose reeds along the river look alright for makin' a pole out of. If you'd gather me some number of them, I'd be willin' to think on you favorably when it comes time to price my merchandise. Oh, and I'll pay you too, of course. $B$BHow's that sound?
LogDescription: Gather 12 Whitepetal Reeds.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Merchant Tantan at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: <He looks down at the dead mogu scout at his feet, looks up at you, then points out out down the lake shore. It seems he wants you to find and kill more of these mogu scouts.>
LogDescription: Kill 8 Shao-Tien Surveyors.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I was kicking the water for fun again when one of those vicious crocolisks lunged out to try to bite my foot off! Rude! I have proceeded to rest my weary soles a few feet farther from the water, but I already look back on my water-kicking days longingly.$B$BWould you be so kind as to kill a crocolisk or eight for me? I assure you they deserve it for frightening me though.
LogDescription: Kill 6 Stillwater Crocolisks.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Ren Firetongue at Whitepetal Lake in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I offer you my heartfelt appreciation for your aid. Anji awaits you in the Setting Sun Garrison to the west.$B$BMay the day favor you, young $c.
LogDescription: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.

QuestDescription: Brew Blanche's Boomer Brew by Protecting the Brewkegs.
LogDescription: Help create the Boomer Brew. If the Brewkegs catch on fire, fix them!
QuestCompletionLog: Talk to Blanche.

QuestDescription: We've been granted a brief respite from the mogu attacks as they attempt to recoup near the Five Sisters to our north. I would like you to see to it that they not be granted a similar reprieve.$B$BShow no mercy.
LogDescription: Kill 8 Shao-Tien mogu near the Five Sisters.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: You see the shiny stones in the walls? Rook wants some. The mogu been collecting them, so they have some to take too maybe.$B$BIf you find stones, you please bring them to Rook? Rook will be your friend.
LogDescription: Collect 12 Guo-Lai Runestones.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rook Stonetoe at the Ruins of Guo-Lai in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: A single large mogu performing a ritual on the lake caught your attention while you were killing the other mogu in the area. It seems unwise to let his ritual complete.
LogDescription: Kill Shadowmaster Sydow and recover the beads from his corpse.
QuestCompletionLog: Bring the Soul-Gatherer's Beads to He Softfoot at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Xuen trusted me to watch kittens. I like kittens. They are small things and funny.$b$bBut I lost kittens. They are strong and many.$b$bXuen sure to say I can no longer watch kittens. I must find kittens. Will you help?$b$bTake my special cage and it will put them in a safe place.
LogDescription: Collect 8 Litters of Xuen.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Groundskeeper Ponch at the Tiger Temple in Kun-Lai Summit.

QuestDescription: Reports suggest that things are quiet at Whitepetal Lake today, but I've dispatched Ren Firetongue and He Softfoot to make sure it stays they way.$B$BIf you want to aid the effort further, head to the west to the lake, meet up with He, and help him keep things secure from any hostile threats.
LogDescription: Speak to He Softfoot at Whitepetal Lake.

QuestDescription: Scouts bring me reports of a powerful Imperion that slipped through our lines in the south and is now heading for the road in the eastern vale.$B$BI need someone I can trust to stop it. Find it and kill it quickly, $n.
LogDescription: Kill General Temuja.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Leven Dawnblade at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Anji came by and asked for you. Said she was heading to the northeast ruins.$B$BOh, Anji, such a fiery spirit, that girl! Probably better for your long-term health if you not keep her waiting.
LogDescription: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.

QuestDescription: My scouts have spotted no mogu near Mistfall Village today, but I've been hearing of some troubles with local wildlife and spirits in the graveyard. I dispatched Che to assess the situation, but he'll most likely need your help.$B$BFind your way southwest to the village and meet Che there. Do what you can.
LogDescription: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.

QuestDescription: Mogu have been sighted at Mistfall Village to the southwest. I dispatched Rook and Sun immediately, but I need another capable hand there as soon as possible.$B$BDon't delay. The villagers need you.
LogDescription: Speak to Sun Tenderheart at Mistfall Village.

QuestDescription: Leven came by in quite a huff! Said something about mogu in the ruins.$B$BBest be off to find him I think. Angry Leven is not a fun Leven.
LogDescription: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.

QuestDescription: Che stopped by on the way to the village and ask if I'd seen you. I told him no.$B$BYou can go see him if you want. But now you're not obligated to see him! I am so marvelously considerate, am I not?
LogDescription: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.

QuestDescription: I can see smoke from the village. And it's not my fault this time!$B$BBest go and help.
LogDescription: Speak to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village.

QuestDescription: Anji and Kun stopped by on the way to the garrison. Lovely pair, don't you think? So different, yet so devoted to each other... ah, it makes my heart swoon just thinking about it.$B$BThey asked for you by name. Maybe they want to put you through some of the training paces? I certainly hope they don't have something more naughty in mind...
LogDescription: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.

QuestDescription: I've instructed Anji and Kun to resume investigation of the Ruins of Guo-Lai. We have no reports of any significant mogu presence there today, but it seems to be one of their central interests here in the Vale, and want it under thorough watch consider their attack on the lake.$B$BThat's why I'm sending you as well.$B$BHead west, past the lake, to the ruins. Anji will instruct you further.
LogDescription: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.

QuestDescription: Everything I've heard suggests the village has been unaffected by the Shao-Tien offensive at the lake, but I won't take any risks.$B$BI'm dispatching you and Che Wildwalker to keep watch at the village, and aid the townsfolk while you're there.
LogDescription: Speak to Che Wildwalker at Mistfall Village.

QuestDescription: We've taken losses from the mogu forces descending the Golden Stair and their flanking attackers at Whitepetal Lake. Our lines are thin.$B$BI'm dispatching Anji and Kun to the Setting Sun Garrison to double our efforts at training new recruits. I'd like you there with them, $n. Show them what a true $c is made of.
LogDescription: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Garrison.

QuestDescription: PH
LogDescription: PH
QuestCompletionLog: PH

QuestDescription: Ah, adventurer. You come at a most opportune time. My daughter and I are researching the history of our people and have hit a roadblock in our research.$b$bShould you come across fragments of the pandaren past, please, bring them to us here. We would benefit greatly from the additional information.
LogDescription: Obtain 20 Pandaren Archaeology Fragments.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Master Liu at the Seat of Knowledge in Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Leven sent Rook here to stop mogu, but there are more than Rook can kill alone.$B$BYou help?  Rook will tell Leven you helped.  Promise.
LogDescription: Kill 8 Shado-Tien attackers in Mistfall Village.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rook Stonetoe at Mistfall Village in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I have my heartfelt thanks for your continued aid. Anji awaits at the Ruins of Guo-Lai to northwest.$B$BGo with courage in your heart, young $c.
LogDescription: Speak to Angi Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.

LogTitle: Mogu within the Ruins of Guo-Lai
QuestDescription: Thank you for your help, $c.$B$BI would enjoy your company for longer, but Leven is leading an attack on the mogu within the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the northwest, and awaits your capable hands.$B$BMay the celestials protect you, young one.
LogDescription: Speak to Leven Dawnblade at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.

QuestDescription: The villagers seem to be safe and the mogu are losing their foothold. We should be able to handle the rest from here. Thank you for your kind aid, $n.$B$BAnji lead a group to investigate and clear out the Ruins of Guo-Lai to the northwest this morning. I am certain she would appreciate someone as capable as yourself. You should go to her.
LogDescription: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Ruins of Guo-Lai.

QuestDescription: The mogu will not be able to maintain this attack much longer. We should be able to handle it here, thanks to your kind aid.$B$BMight you be willing to find Anji at the Setting Sun Training Camp to the west? She's been tasked with preparing fresh-faced pandaren to aid the cause. You could show them a thing or two as well, I imagine.
LogDescription: Speak to Anji Autumnlight at the Setting Sun Training Camp.

LogTitle: Attack At The Temple of the Jade Serpent
QuestDescription: Darkness enshrouds the Temple of the Jade Serpent, and Yu'Lon's priests beseech us for aid.$B$BThey hold the sha in check, but just barely.$B$BYou may be able to turn the tide, $c.
LogDescription: Speak to Elder Sage Tai-Feng at the Jade Temple Grounds in The Jade Forest.

LogTitle: Attack At The Temple of the Jade Serpent

LogTitle: Challenge At The Temple of the Red Crane
QuestDescription: The Temple of the Red Crane still reels from the aftermath of the sha's presence, and has only recently gathered to rebuild and retrain its warriors.$B$BIf you wish to help at the temple, speak to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji.
LogDescription: Speak to Thelonius at the Cradle of Chi-Ji in the Krasarang Wilds.

LogTitle: Trial At The Temple of the White Tiger
QuestDescription: Xuen, the great Celestial of the North, seeks the greatest champions in the land.$B$BToday, he holds trials of battle at his temple in Kun-Lai Summit.$B$BIf you wish to test yourself against skilled fighters from all across Pandaria, then go to him and enter the challenger's ring!
LogDescription: Speak to Xuen at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.

QuestDescription: Niuzao Temple, far to the west, is under attack by the mantid.$B$BThe great Celestial holds them back for now, but he cannot stand alone forever.$B$BGo and help the defenders, $c. The Temple must not fall!
LogDescription: Speak to Ogo the Elder at Niuzao Temple in the Townlong Steppes.

QuestDescription: Niuzao Temple, far to the west, is under attack by the mantid.$B$BThe great Celestial holds them back for now, but he cannot stand alone forever.$B$BGo and help the defenders, $c. The Temple must not fall!

QuestDescription: Xuen once issued this challenge to the last Emperor of Pandaria: stand in the center of the room and hold off waves of monks using only a ten foot pole.$b$bMy record is ten. Can you beat that?
LogDescription: Hold back at least 10 Tiger Temple Monks using the Ten Foot Pole.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Lin Tenderpaw at the Tiger Temple in Kun-Lai Summit.

QuestDescription: Xuen has this challenge he says helps "refine strength." I am starting to think the word "strength" means something different to him than the rest of us.$b$bHere, take this torch to the top of the gates of the temple. If you can get it there without the torch being extinguished, you pass the challenge.$b$bWhatever you do, do not try carrying the torch on a mount. It will blow out if you do. Trust me on that one.
LogDescription: Carry the Torch of Strength to the gates of the Temple of the White Tiger without it extinguishing.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Lin Tenderpaw at the Temple of the White Tiger in Kun-Lai Summit.

The items will be catalogued, and the most exceptional cuts stored in a secret vault, while the rest are sold to refresh our funds.$b$bOur goal is to eventually create a unique collection for a special event.
LogDescription: Bring the requested goods to any member of the Pandaria Treasure Society in The Valley of Eternal Blossoms.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to any member of the Pandaria Treasure Society in The Valley of Eternal Blossoms.
