QuestDescription: Those mogu cannons up on the Golden Stair are bombarding us from a distance. Sure would be nice if they somehow spontaneously broke, don't you think?
LogDescription: Destroy 7 Shao-Tien Cannons.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: I can hear the screams of the captured soldiers and villagers up on the Golden Stair. They're torturing them!$B$BPlease, please, you have to save them!
LogDescription: Rescue 5 Golden Lotus Guards or Mistfall Villagers.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sun Tenderheart at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu are conjuring some kind of sinister storm upon the Golden Stair. Generally, mogu and lightning are not a particularly pleasant mix. I say we stop them.$B$BYou should be able to find their Stormcaller staves pretty easily, considering the giant arcs of lightning extending up from them. Mind knocking them over or destroying them or something for me? I sure would sleep better.
LogDescription: Destroy the Stormcaller staves.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The Shao-Tien have unleashed their captive tortured spirits upon us. They flood down from the Golden Stair, with no end in sight.$B$BKill as many of these unleashed spirits as you can. They are fragile, but if you are not alert, they can easily overrun you.$B$BGood luck.
LogDescription: Kill 12 Unleashed Spirits.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Lao Softfoot got himself captured again up on the Golden Stair. I'm not going to make any excuses for him, he's a lousy rogue.$B$BWe probably shouldn't just leave him there though. Could you go find him?
LogDescription: Rescue Lao Softfoot.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Kun Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

LogTitle: [RESCUE GOLDEN LOTUS SQUAD] [GET RID OF THIS?]
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu are empowering some giant stone monstrosity up on the Golden Stair, with the sure intent of unleashing it upon us.$B$BHow about you go and let them know our opinion on the matter? Make sure the point strikes home.
LogDescription: Stop the Shao-Tien Behemoth from being empowered.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu have piled the bodies of our brethren high at the top of the Golden Stair, and are conducting some foul ritual to tear their spirits from their bodies and turn them on us.$B$BFind this ritual and stop it. Leave them a firm reminder of what will happen if they attempt this again.
LogDescription: Stop the Shao-Tien Spirit Ritual.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: The mogu have succeeded in empowering an enormous stone statue with the intent of unleashing it upon us.$B$BIn response, I would like to unleash you upon it.$B$BIt approaches from the Golden Stair. Bring it to its knees...
LogDescription: Destroy the Shao-Tien Behomoth.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.
Return to Anji Autumnlight at the Golden Pagoda in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.

QuestDescription: Think you can take me again?  I'm always up for challenge!
LogDescription: Defeat Lindsay in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Lindsay.

QuestDescription: You climbed this mountain once more only to face your own demise.
LogDescription: Defeat Dagra the Fierce in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Dagra the Fierce.

QuestDescription: Ah, so you've braved the woods again to face me in battle. I accept your brazen challenge to my vicious spawn.
LogDescription: Defeat Eric Davidson in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Eric Davidson.

QuestDescription: So ye've come fer another round, have ye?$B$BI'll show ya why they be callin' me the shcourge o' the vale!
LogDescription: Defeat Bill Buckler in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Bill Buckler.

QuestDescription: You dare to challenge me again? This time, I do believe our battle is going to sway in my favor!
LogDescription: Defeat Steven Lisbane in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Steven Lisbane.

QuestDescription: I see you have once again found me. I presume you wish to do battle once more? Yes, let's.
LogDescription: Defeat Analynn in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Analynn.

QuestDescription: The prey be walkin' to the predator's territory, unaware of the danger that $g he:she; is in. You be givin' Zonya no trouble dis time.
LogDescription: Defeat Zonya the Sadist in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Zonya the Sadist.

QuestDescription: You beat Gluk before, but now Gluk lay da smackdown on puny $r!
LogDescription: Defeat Traitor Gluk in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Traitor Gluk.

QuestDescription: Just as the land continues to grow, my team is stronger than ever. Are you sure you wish to combat me? There is no shame in admitting defeat now.
LogDescription: Defeat Merda Stronghoof in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Merda Stronghoof.

QuestDescription: It's time to put your battle skills to a true test.$b$bYou will find Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!
LogDescription: Defeat Steven Lisbane in a pet battle.

QuestDescription: It's time to put your battle skills to a true test.$b$bYou will find Steven Lisbane wandering the roads in the southern parts of Northern Stranglethorn. Seek him out and see who the superior tamer is!
LogDescription: Defeat Steven Lisbane in a pet battle.

QuestDescription: I've loaded my pets with new gyrotechnic training modules. You're going down!
LogDescription: Defeat Cassandra Kaboom in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Cassandra Kaboom.

QuestDescription: You're back?! You're just asking to get eaten by a black dragon!
LogDescription: Defeat Grazzle the Great in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Grazzle the Great.

QuestDescription: You're so bold as to venture into the heart of Grimtotem lands once more to challenge me? You will regret your decision!
LogDescription: Defeat Kela Grimtotem in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Kela Grimtotem.

QuestDescription: With each passing day my power grows. Resistance is futile.
LogDescription: Defeat Zoltan in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Zoltan.

QuestDescription: I see you're ready for another bout in the skies. Let's take flight!
LogDescription: Defeat Elena Flutterfly in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Elena Flutterfly.

QuestDescription: My research has helped my training regimen greatly. I will defeat you this time.
LogDescription: Defeat David Kosse in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to David Kosse.

QuestDescription: You have not yet turned to the true path of undeath. Perhaps another battle will show you the way.
LogDescription: Defeat Deiza Plaguehorn in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Deiza Plaguehorn.

QuestDescription: I hear that you fought my fool of a brother. He lost, eh?$B$BLooks like this is my time to shine!
LogDescription: Defeat Kortas Darkhammer in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Kortas Darkhammer.

QuestDescription: I believe I'm figuring out the secrets of this place. Soon I will be unstoppable!
LogDescription: Defeat Everessa in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Everessa.

QuestDescription: My time under the Firelord has prepared me fer anything. Nothing you can throw at me will deter me!
LogDescription: Defeat Durin Darkhammer in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Durin Darkhammer.

QuestDescription: You wish to face me again? You will regret this decision!
LogDescription: Defeat Lydia Accoste in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Lydia Accoste.

QuestDescription: According to my calculations, I have a 32.333% chance of victory. I'll take it!
LogDescription: Defeat Nicki Tinytech in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Nicki Tinytech.

QuestDescription: You want to fight again? I think I've gotten better!
LogDescription: Defeat Ras'an in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Ras'an.

QuestDescription: I wish to do battle once more. These young ones need to grow stronger.
LogDescription: Defeat Narrok in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Narrok.

QuestDescription: I have learned much since our last encounter. Do you wish to test your skills once more?
LogDescription: Defeat Morulu The Elder in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Morulu The Elder.

QuestDescription: You capitalized on my mistake last time and emerged victorious. This time, you will not be so fortunate, $r.
LogDescription: Defeat Bloodknight Antari in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Bloodknight Antari.

QuestDescription: One of my chickens flew for just a moment yesterday, I swear. We're finally hitting the big time!$B$BOh, you'd like to battle again?
LogDescription: Defeat Beegle Blastfuse in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Beegle Blastfuse.

QuestDescription: Time and time again you defy my wisdom. What is it that brings you back to these woods?$B$BAh, you wish to do battle once more. Very well then.
LogDescription: Defeat Nearly Headless Jacob in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Nearly Headless Jacob.

QuestDescription: You dare interrupt our work? Then you must battle me again! Take out your pets, and I'll give you a taste of Hellscream's wrath!
LogDescription: Defeat Okrut Dragonwaste in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Okrut Dragonwaste.

QuestDescription: Me like fighting you. You not so easy like the others. We fight again?
LogDescription: Defeat Gutretch in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Gutretch.

QuestDescription: The rebel $c comes once again to test $g his:her; might again that of a Grand Master. Your bravery will be your undoing this time!
LogDescription: Defeat Major Payne in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Major Payne.

QuestDescription: This time I'm gonna do the beating! You watch!
LogDescription: Defeat Mo'ruk in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Mo'ruk.

QuestDescription: I see the triumphant tamer returns to again test $G himself:herself; against me. Very well. I accept your challenge.
LogDescription: Defeat Obalis in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Obalis.

QuestDescription: I do not yet understand the plight of these creatures well enough to help them sufficiently. Perhaps another battle would strengthen our bond?
LogDescription: Defeat Brok in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Brok.

QuestDescription: The natives have taught me the strength of the earth. I know it's unending endurance. Let us battle once more, and you'll see that I'm tougher than ever!
LogDescription: Defeat Bordin Steadyfist in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Bordin Steadyfist.

QuestDescription: The power of twilight flows through me. I am a god! You have no hope of defeating me!
LogDescription: Defeat Goz Banefury in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Goz Banefury.

QuestDescription: You've caught a unique fish... with wings.  Perhaps it deserves the expert opinion of Nat Pagle in Anglers Wharf.
LogDescription: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.
QuestCompletionLog: Bring the Flying Tiger Gourami to Nat Pagle at Anglers Wharf.

QuestDescription:
When I ordered the excavation of the tunnel to the northwest, I thought we'd find something useful. Gold, iron... anything!

Instead, we found mogu artifacts, and I get a bunch of dwarves from the Explorers' League to baby-sit.

I hear from the soldiers that there's trouble in the mines. I have orders from Wrynn that I have to support the Explorers' League, but I can't spare any troops. Can you get down there and find out what's going on?
LogDescription: Meet with Hilda Hornswaggle at the Ruins of Ogudei in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: The Alliance has made landfall. If we do not defeat them here, any hope of a Horde presence on this continent is lost.$b$bGo to the battlefield south of here and slay Alliance you find.$b$bShow them how any Horde who still stands on two legs will be the death of ten Alliance!
LogDescription: Defeat 10 Alliance soldiers in Domination Point.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Shokia at Domination Point in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
I've got some customers lined up that wanna collect some good old fashioned ears. But not any old ears. They only want the absolute waxiest ears money can buy! 

Guess they think they're lucky or something'.

Anyways, I need you to go get 'em for me. I don't want to hurt any animals, so you'll need to get 'em from the Alliance over at Lion's Landing.

Have fun - and remember, only bring me the waxiest!
LogDescription: Collect 10 Extra-Waxy Alliance Ears at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
Gnomes are excavating a stone quarry to the northeast.

They're building stuff with it!

<Zazzix rolls his eyes.>

They're too stupid to realize it's special mogu stone for creating animated statues. 

WE can mix with a little Goblin magic juice to make some real big explosions!

But the stuff is heavy. They've got some of their stupid bomb-bots there for excavating the stone. Blow 'em up near slabs and you'll get chunks small enough to carry. 

Or, just kill 'em and take it. Whatever works.
LogDescription: Collect 20 Animatable Stone chunks from the Lion's Landing quarry. Lion's Landing Engineers carry them, or you can destroy stone slabs with collateral damage to blow them into chunks you can carry.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Lion's Landing.

QuestDescription:
Our goblin friends do not have the grasp of strategy necessary to win a long term engagement, I'm afraid.

The key to eliminating any permanent establishment is to attack their ability to replenish their troops and to rebuild.

In this case, that means taking out their Peasants. Kill them, and you weaken the foundation. The rest of the keep is bound to crumble.
LogDescription: Kill 30 Lion's Landing Peasants.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
We've spotted heavy air support over their base, in the form of way too many dwarves on way too many griffons. Means we can't get any vision of the area from above.

A troll... friend of mine gave us a set of Sentry Wards, which we can use to spy on their base and get a vantage point on what's going on in there.

Bad news, friend - you're going to be the one going in there.
LogDescription: Place Sentry Wards on the Docks, in the Town Hall, and on the Second Floor of the Barracks at Lion's Landing.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
We've managed to get some Demolishers on the beach, but the stupid dwarves are also out there with their stupid mortar tubes, preventing the Demolishers from pushing forward and assaulting the keep itself!

Get out there, kill some dwarves, and blow up some mortar tubes.
LogDescription: Kill 8 Lion's Landing Mortar Team Engineers and destroy 2 Lion's Landing Mortar Tubes.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Zazzix "Toasty" Sparkrocket at Sparkrocket Outpost in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
There are some situations in which taking out one of their soldiers is more important than killing hundreds.

They've deployed some of their heroes to the battlefield to help rally their defenders. Not only will killing them soften their defense, it will also leave their morale crippled.

So go, take one down for me. You can handle it.
LogDescription: Kill an Alliance Hero at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Shademaster Kiryn at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: Everyday it's the same thing! "We're out of this!", "We need more of that!", "Why don't you ever do anything?!"$b$bI work! I do things! They can be so hurtful! I'm doin' my best down here!$b$bOh yeah, we need more lumber! Go down and tell that good for nothin' Zino to get his shredders in gear!
LogDescription: Find Zino "The Shredder" Quickchop in the Lumber Farm.

QuestDescription: The orcs can NOT be allowed a foothold in this land. They will defile it just as they did Kalimdor.$b$b$p, I need boots on the ground and horde in their graves. Get down to the coastline and bring the full force of Alliance wrath down on their heads!$b$bSlay any orcs you find. Take the wind out of their sails.$b$bFor the King!
LogDescription: Slay 10 Orcs at Domination Point.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: Greetings $p! I have heard a lot about your success in the field. I would like to use your services to test my latest "Siege-o-Matic", a device of terrible and varied abilities.$b$bI promise it is mostly harmless to its users.$b$bWhen you are around Domination Point be on the look out for my Scout-o-Meters. They have been dispatched to get info on good siege targets. When you find one, activate it and I will pilot a Siege-o-Matic to your location.$b$bSee you in the field... as it were.
LogDescription: Find the three Scout-o-Matics in Domination Point.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with the Tinkmaster Overspark on the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: The Horde are consumed by pride and will fight to the death without a second thought.$b$bWe need to find a way to break their will that does not involve massive loss of our numbers.$b$bLook for the Horde supplies along the coastline and near their ships. Smash their supplies.$b$bNothing breaks the will of a defender like seeing their hope of food go up in a puff of smoke.$b$bWhen you are done, find Sully behind enemy lines. He has the next task for you.
LogDescription: Destroy 8 Horde Supply Crates.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Mishka aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: My probes have detected three very dangerous targets in the courtyard of Domination Keep.$b$bThey have an ogre emissary, a Kor'kron officer, and an insane goblin bomb maker.$B$BMy siege-o-matics are not ready for one on one combat so it is up to you to eliminate the targets.$b$bGood luck! Report back to me on the Skyfire when done.
LogDescription: Defeat Stone Guard Ruk'ra, Bombgineer Snicklefritz, and Or'Dac.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Tinkmaster Overspark aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: It looks like the Horde thinks they can hide behind their heavy hitting mooks.$b$bThe mooks are tough, powerful, and dumber than an ogre with a hangover.$b$bGo down there and bring the hammer of the Alliance fury down on them!
LogDescription: Kill 5 Heavy Mooks.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak with Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
Sure, they've got about plenty of grunts out there, pounding on our door, waiting to cut our heads off.

I'm not worried about grunts. But they've got shamans and raiders, too. The shamans use their magic to empower the grunts, and the raiders are fast and specialize in taking out our buildings.

I need you to get out there and kill some of those shamans and raiders.

Go! Attack! Move!
LogDescription: Kill 12 Dominance Shamans or Dominance Raiders.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
Oh, the poor peasants...

They are cowards, yes, of course. But they don't know how to fight, and they go out to collect lumber for our efforts... the Horde targets them... It's just awful all around!

But, we need that lumber if we're going to hold out. Go out and collect any they've dropped.
LogDescription: Collect 12 Lion's Landing Lumber by recovering it from piles of Hastily Abandoned Lumber.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Mishka at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
The Horde decided to put goblins in charge of their logistics. And where you have goblins, you have carelessly placed explosives.

Scouts have reported that they have their supplies in carts that also contain demolisher ammunition. Look at those crates the wrong way, and they'll blow sky high. 

With enough Horde resources destroyed, we'll put a time limit on their attack and save lives. So go and take out those carts!
LogDescription: Destroy 8 Domination Point Supply Carts.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Mishka at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
The gnomes are running our quarry operation to the northwest. The stone there is especially tough - the gnomes tell me the mogu used it to fashion their constructs. 

I don't know. What I do know is that we use that stone to build our towers, and the Horde has dispatched the Bilgewater goblins to steal it from us.

Get out there and get some back. By the way - collateral damage may break up the stone slabs there. If so, pick that up, too.
LogDescription: Collect 20 Animatable Stone at the Lion's Landing Quarry from Bilgewater Goblins or by destroying stone slabs there with collateral damage.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
The Horde got the bright idea to send Bilgewater goblins to attack our quarry.

They've been packing heavy explosives - heavy explosives that will react with the ammunition in their demolishers.

Kill the Bilgewater goblins until you find an explosive, plant it on one of the demolishers... and BOOM! Siege ended.
LogDescription: Find a Bilgewater Blasting Cap on a Bilgewater Sapper, and then plant it on a Domination Point Demolisher.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription:
Look, you're tough. Tougher than the rest of the men and women I've got here. Which means I need you for a special mission.

The Horde is throwing their best against us. Heroes of their armies - Blademasters, Tauren Chieftans, you name it.

I need you to go take one out. It'll be a huge blow, not just to their offensive but also to morale.
LogDescription: Kill a Horde Hero.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Marshal Troteman at Lion's Landing in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: Those goblins are gettin' out of hand! First they level the forest and set up that abomination of a rig. Then, they start dumpin' their oil barrels into the bay!$b$bWe got to put a stop to this madness! At the very least we need ta set them back.$b$bWe need to take out their fuel supply! Maybe you'll even get to kill a few goblins in the process!
LogDescription: Use the Unstable Explosive to destroy the Northestern Fuel Tank, Northern Fuel Tank, and the Northwestern Fuel Tank.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

QuestDescription: It goes against me nature to break things on purpose, but in this case it's necessary.$b$bThat rig the goblins are usin' is held together by a wish an' some bubblegum. We need to exploit the situation a little more.$b$bWe have some saboteurs down there already, but we can use someone of your expertise to hurry the job along.$b$bGet down there an' start breakin' and stealin' some valves!
LogDescription: Steal 7 Rusty Valves from the fuel operation on Bilgewater Beach.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

QuestDescription: This is barbaric warfare, $c! We've lost so many trying to keep the Bilgewater operation from spreading any further.$b$bThose fallen soldiers fought honorably and deserved to be given their last rights. At the very least we need to be able to notify their next of kin.$b$bPerhaps you can collect their identification tags so we can honor them in some small way.
LogDescription: Retrieve 7 Shieldwall Soldier Dog Tags from the Fallen Shieldwall Soldiers in and around Bilgewater Beach.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Mishka aboard the Skyfire in the Southern Isles.

QuestDescription: The destruction in Krasarang is unforgivable, $c. The only way to put an end to this is to destroy the Bilgewater operation.$b$bThis is for the greater good of Pandaria and the Alliance. Go to Bilgewater Beach and cut them down! No doubt the Horde will come to their assistance.$b$bDestroy them!
LogDescription: Kill 10 Bilgewater Goblins in and around Bilgewater Beach.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire.

QuestDescription: Shredmaster Packle is responsible for much of the devastation down there, $c.$b$bRumor has it he modified the shredders to work more quickly with less regard for the collateral damage they can inflict.$b$bImagine the agony the trees must endure being hacked at. It will be difficult to recover from this level of destruction.$b$bThe first step in any recovery is acknowledging the problem. Step two is eliminating that problem.
LogDescription: Destroy Shredmaster Packle in Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Seraphine of the Winter aboard the Skyfire.

QuestDescription: We should attempt to offset the destruction being wrought on this continent as much as possible. For every tree they destroy, we will plant a new one!$b$bTake these seeds and begin the regrowth process, $n.$b$bDo not linger for too long though. Nature is unpredictable, and no doubt the anger and hate exuding from Domination Point has seeped into the ground.$b$bI cannot guarantee that the plant that springs from these seeds will not be hostile.
LogDescription: Plant 11 Energized Seeds near Quickchop's Lumber Farm.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Seraphine of the Winter aboard the Skyfire.

QuestDescription: The ancient crane is alive, but stunned.$b$bYou should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.
LogDescription: Bring the Ancient Bloodcrown Crane to Jorn Skyseer.

QuestDescription: The elder cat is alive, but stunned.$b$bYou should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.
LogDescription: Bring the Krasari Elder to Jorn Skyseer.

QuestDescription: The colossal crab is alive, but stunned.$b$bYou should bring it back to Jorn Skyseer before it wakes up.
LogDescription: Bring the Colossal Viseclaw to Jorn Skyseer.

QuestDescription: The ancient crane is alive, but stunned.$b$bYou should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.
LogDescription: Bring the Ancient Bloodcrown Crane to Huntsman Blake.

QuestDescription: The elder cat is alive, but stunned.$b$bYou should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.
LogDescription: Bring the Krasari Elder to Huntsman Blake.

QuestDescription: The colossal crab is alive, but stunned.$b$bYou should bring it back to Huntsman Blake before it wakes up.
LogDescription: Bring the Colossal Viseclaw to Huntsman Blake.

QuestDescription: We've been gettin' complaints right and left that the Boss-Lady gets all the good grub and leaves the scraps for the others.$b$bBetween you and I, they may be onto somethin' here. I don't even get to eat as good as she does!$b$bWe need somethin' Sezik can make a lot of that at least attempts to disguise how inedible the food is here...$b$bI got it! Mystery Meatloaf!
LogDescription: Obtain 7 Chunks of Mystery Meat from the local wildlife.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sezik Steampot on Bilgewater Beach near the Boiling Crustacean.

QuestDescription: The Boss-Lady desires crabs!$b$bWhy are you looking at me like that? It's not uncommon for a classy person, such as her loveliness, to want crab for dinner. What did you think I meant?$b$bThere are some big crabs wandering around on Bilgewater Beach that should be suitable for her refined palate.$b$bBring Sezik the best crab meat you can find!
LogDescription: Obtain 5 chunks of Polluted Viseclaw Meat from the Viseclaw crabs on Bilgewater Beach.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sezik Steampot on Bilgewater Beach near the Boiling Crustacean.
Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

LogTitle: Kill mogu boss for key, use object behind jumping puzzle

QuestDescription: There is nothing more unnerving than walking along, minding your own business, and hearing someone following you. I swear I hear it all over the place down here! We're being watched!$B$BI have a feeling the entire beach is just crawling with spies!$b$bI made some improvements to our infrared goggle tech to put an end to the sabotogery. That's right sabotogery! Now I just need you to try 'em out! Feel free to dispose of any spies you happen to catch.
LogDescription: Kill 10 SI: 7 Saboteurs around Domination Point and Bilgewater Beach.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Domination Point.

QuestDescription: Our lumber supply is being jeopardized by constant attacks from Lion's Landing.$b$bWe've been able to keep the attackers at bay, but it's time to really show 'em some muscle!$b$bHead down to the coast and start splitting some skulls!
LogDescription: Kill any 10 Shieldwall Forces including SI: 7 Saboteurs in and around Bilgewater Beach.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Rivett Clutchpop in Domination Point.

QuestDescription: The Kirin Tor have gone too far! Now they hold our fellow Sunreavers as war prisoners!$b$bThere will be no discussion of prisoner exchange. We will handle this ourselves.$b$bGo to Violet Rise and free as many prisoners as you can. Do not get captured yourself. We cannot afford to lose you too.
LogDescription: Free 5 Sunreaver Captives around Violet Rise.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Magister Hathorel at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

QuestDescription: Ah, $p, just the $r I was looking for. I have received another batch of tactical mana bombs that I need planted in key positions across Violet Rise to the southeast.$b$bHere, take these. I do not trust our standard soldiers with such firepower. Oh... and don't shake them, whatever you do.$b$bPlant one of the Kirin Tor ships, another one near their supplies, and the last on the construct they are building.
LogDescription: Plant a Tactical Mana Bomb on an Alliance Ship, Alliance Supply Shipment, and on the Construct Ritual.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Girana the Blooded at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

QuestDescription:
The Zandalari train skyscreamers to become ferocious beasts in the skies. The spiritbinders require endless sacrifices - of our people - to be brought to them. And, the jaguar warriors venture ever closer toward the heart of our camp.

Find them in Za'Tual and remove the threat.
LogDescription: Slay 3 Zandalari Spiritbinders, 3 Zandalari Beastcallers, and 3 Zandalari Jaguar Warriors.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Halduron Brightwing at the Isle of Thunder.

LogTitle: Kill Mogu Blood-seekers (Roaming pairs, actively fighting scouts, and performing rituals on corpses)

QuestDescription:
The forge lies ahead of you, and with it the heart of the mogu's weaponsmithing ability.

And beyond that, the mogu gatekeeper, who holds the key to unlocking the gate to the next part of the city.

It's time to move out!
LogDescription: Kill the Master of the Forge and collect a Codex Fragment from Fleshcrafter Hoku in the Isle of Thunder.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Scout Captain Elsia.

QuestDescription: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?
LogDescription: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

QuestDescription: Grezik Oregrind has become a nuisance that must be eliminated.$b$bThis land responds to all of our actions as I am sure you are aware, $c. Because of this, we cannot allow the goblins to haphazardly destroy it.$b$bOur scouts have reported Sha emerging from Oregrind's Dig. The brains behind the operation is a goblin named Grezik Oregrind.$b$bDestroy him and perhaps we will stall the operation just long enough to contain the Sha.
LogDescription: Destroy Grezik Oregrind at Oregrind's Dig.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire.

QuestDescription: You're back!  Up for another battle with me?
LogDescription: Defeat Whispering Pandaren Spirit in a pet battle.
QuestCompletionLog: Speak to Whispering Pandaren Spirit.

QuestDescription: Those shredders are becoming a problem down there, $c.$b$bWe've sent in the Mecha-Pounders, but it just isn't enough. They're getting damaged faster than we can repair 'em!$b$bI happened upon this strange remote while scouting. With a little bit of re-configurin' I think we can use it.$b$bTry usin' it on the Jungle Shredders. Hopefully it will destroy them and then you can bring me the scrap metal.
LogDescription: Destroy the Jungle Shredders using the Re-Configured Remote and then collect 6 pieces of Scrap Metal.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Sully "The Pickle" McLeary aboard the Skyfire.

QuestDescription: Now we take the fight to them, $c!$b$bReport to Shademaster Kiryn in Sparkrocket Outpost. She will have your orders.$b$bNow we'll see how they handle the full might of the Horde rushing at their precious keep!
LogDescription: Report to Shademaster Kiryn in Sparkrocket Outpost.

QuestDescription: It's time we show these Horde mongrels the full strength of the Alliance! Today we bring the battle to their door.$b$bReport to Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire. She will have further instructions.$b$bGood luck out there, $c. Do the Alliance proud!
LogDescription: Report to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: We're fighting a war on all fronts, $c. Even Pandaria itself needs our protection.$b$bThe Bilgewater goblins are destroying land that doesn't belong to them. They must be stopped!$b$bReport to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire. From her vantage point she should have a good idea of where their weak spots are.
LogDescription: Report to Sky Admiral Rogers aboard the Skyfire in Krasarang Wilds.

QuestDescription: My scouts have spotted a Zandalari war party on the northern beach. I need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?
LogDescription: Kill Nurkala, the Zandalari War Leader.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

QuestDescription: My scouts have spotted a mogu leader under the central tower. He needs to be killed before he can mount an offensive on our position.$B$BCan you take care of this for me?
LogDescription: Kill Horgak the Enslaver.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Lor'themar Theron at the Dawnseeker Promontory.

QuestDescription: We need to counter the beasts the Zandalari are using to strike at our camp. I have dispatched Scout Captain Elsia to the Beast Pens along with some war mages to provide cover.$b$bGo and find her east of here near the breaches in the wall and help her trim down the cavalry and siege beasts being levied against us.$b$bThey are masked, so look for the shimmers of their magical cloaking spells.
LogDescription: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens.
QuestCompletionLog: Find Scout Captain Elsia at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

QuestDescription: Do you hear that, $c? The beating of war drums in the distance. The Zandalari are preparing for us.$b$bLet's not give them the luxury of time to organize their defenses. We need to push the attack now!$b$bReport to Scout Captain Elsia within Conqueror's Terrace. She will have further orders for you.
LogDescription: Locate Scout Captain Elsia within Conqueror's Terrace.

QuestDescription: One of my scryers has identified a Zandalari leader near the central tower. He needs to be removed.$B$BWould you be willing to do this for me, $c?
LogDescription: Kill Arcweaver Jor'guva.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Lor'themar Theron on the Crimson Treader.

QuestDescription: We've spotted a Zandalari war party down on the beach just outside these walls. We need to eliminate them before returning to camp.$B$BAre you up for the task?
LogDescription: Kill Nurkala, the Zandalari War Leader.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

QuestDescription: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BCan you handle this one?
LogDescription: Kill Arcweaver Jor'guva.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

QuestDescription: We've spotted a Zandalari war party up the beach. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to handle this one?
LogDescription: Kill Nurkala, the Zandalari War Leader.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Scout Captain Elsia north of the Diremoor.

QuestDescription: I do not want to see another Zandalari beast rider breach our defenses!$b$bI have dispatched Scout Captain Daelin and some war mages to the Beast Pens northwest of here. Their mission is to infiltrate and harass the Zandalari siege and cavalry units. I want you to join them and lend your expertise.$b$bKeep an eye out for the tell tale shimmer of their magical cloaking spell.
LogDescription: Find Scout Captain Daelin at the Beast Pens.
QuestCompletionLog: Find Scout Captain Daelin at the Beast Pens on the Isle of Thunder.

QuestDescription: We have accomplished much since arriving here, but now is not the time to rest. Your efforts have helped us breach the upper level of the Thunder King's stronghold.$b$bNow, I call on you to continue our campaign. Report to Scout Captain Daelin within Conqueror's Terrace. He will have further orders for you.
LogDescription: Locate Scout Captain Daelin within Conqueror's Terrace.

QuestDescription: The scouts have spotted a dangerous Zandalari just this side of Za'Tual. We need someone capable to see him dispatched. Are you up to the task?
LogDescription: Kill Arcweaver Jor'guva.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

QuestDescription: We've received word of a Zandalari war party up the beach, north of our foothold. We need them hunted down and killed.$B$BAre you willing to do this thing for us, $c?
LogDescription: Kill Nurkala, the Zandalari War Leader.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

QuestDescription: The scryers have spotted a mogu leader at the central tower. He needs to be killed before he can mount an offensive on our position.$B$BCan you take care of this for us?
LogDescription: Kill Horgak the Enslaver.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Jaina Proudmoore at the Violet Rise.

QuestDescription: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BWould you be willing to do the deed?
LogDescription: Kill Zur'chaka the Bonecrafter.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Scout Captain Daelin north of the Diremoor.

QuestDescription: We've spotted a Zandalari leader up the central stairs. We need to eliminate him before returning to camp.$B$BCan you handle this one?
LogDescription: Kill Arcweaver Jor'guva.
QuestCompletionLog: Return to Scout Captain Daelin north of the Diremoor.

QuestDescription: We've spotted a Zandalari war party down on the beach just outside these walls. We need to eliminate them before returning to camp.$B$BAre you up for the task?
LogDescription: Kill Nurkala, the Zandalari War Leader.
